name: Kansas
sources: Rates and brackets (5.2% up to $23,000 / $46,000 MFJ, 5.58% above): K.S.A. 79-32,110 as amended by 2024 Special Session SB 1 (EY Tax News 2024-1459); 2025 Kansas Tax Table (ksrevenue.gov/incomebook25.html)
No rate reduction for 2026 under SB 269: Kansas DOR Notice 25-06 (ksrevenue.gov/taxnotices/notice25-06.pdf)
Standard deduction, 65+/blind additions, personal and dependent exemptions, itemized deduction rules: Kansas Individual Income Tax Booklet 2025 (ksrevenue.gov/incomebook25.html)
provisional: Standard deduction ($3,605 single, $8,240 MFJ, $4,120 MFS, $6,180 HoH) and 65+ additions are from the 2025 booklet; unchanged from 2024, so not indexed
Exemptions ($9,160 per filer, $2,320 per dependent) are from the 2025 booklet
Extra standard deduction for 65+ is $700 per person here; single and head-of-household filers actually get $850
